issues.detail: The Hebrew 'אֵלוֹן מְעוֹנְנִים' (Elon Meonenim, 'oak of the soothsayers') is rendered as '米惡寧尼橡樹' (Mi'e Ningni oak tree), which appears to be a transliteration error or name swap—'מְעוֹנְנִים' (Meonenim) is not '米惡寧尼' (Mi'e Ningni). The correct transliteration should be '米歐寧寧' or similar, not '米惡寧尼'.
